verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated ISO 27001 product page claiming to help organizations certify to ISO 27001. It also offers AI-powered ISMS templates for roles, responsibilities, and risks, plus automated evidence collection, so ISO 27001 is a named framework rather than a mere mapping. General audit tooling (Auditor API, information request lists, auditor collaboration) supports certification work, but the evidence never shows the specific ISO artifacts the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit support for the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
